svg.text: A FRONT: sink face seen from the board (x right, z up from board top)

bar screw L, M4 tapped through the base

strip 114.5 x 30.0, SIL PAD 2000 0.254 mm; scribe a line 2.5 mm above the bottom edge (sink edge); BR1 hole punched on assembly
